MEASURED.copy: Measured {t}Z. {returned} of {inputs} inputs returned rows. {fails} fails.

DEGRADED.copy: Partial. {n} of {inputs} inputs returned no row and no archived empty-result page. Rows from this arm are shown. Counts carry a partial stamp.

WITHHELD.copy_body: {ARM} collector unhealed since {t} UTC. We do not know, so we will not say.

HEALING.copy: Heal in flight. Step {step} of 7, {stage_name}. {elapsed} elapsed, budget 15m. Rows below are frozen at the {t}Z sweep.

AWAITING_APPROVAL.copy: Proposed template awaiting approval. Canary {pass} of {total} resolving RED on version=dev. Approve is locked until {total} of {total}.

STALE.copy: Last sweep {t}Z, {ago} ago. Exceeds the {bound} freshness bound. Rows are historical. DAY counters are frozen at last capture, not counting.

rejected.copy: Heal rejected {t}Z. Canary GTIN {gtin} did not re-assert on the proposed template. Production template unchanged at {template}. Arm remains withheld. Ledger: {ledger}

approved.copy: Heal approved {t}Z. Template {template}. {pass} of {total} canaries resolved.

page_states.LOADING: full chrome, real headers, 12 skeleton rows at 64px, empty bar tracks, numerals as tabular dashes. No spinner, no shimmer, no progress bar.
page_states.GLOBAL_BLACKOUT: implausible cleanliness fired, >40% sweep-over-sweep drop, whole board black

structural_rules: A rejected heal is a louder state than a successful one. More pixels, names the exact canary that failed, names the unchanged template version.
DAY N freezes when the arm is not measured, and says it froze. A counter that keeps incrementing on stale data is a lie about capture time.
Colour is always paired with a glyph. Deuteranopia and greyscale screenshots both survive.
No detector is allowed to be invisible. Every one writes its verdict into health.json.
